arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm an Alarmo entity with custom settings.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity that should be armed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the arming.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Mode to arm the alarm in.

force.name: Force
force.description: Automatically bypass all sensors that prevent the arming operation.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity that should be disarmed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the disarming.

skip_delay.name: Skip Delay
skip_delay.description: Skip the remainder of the exit/entry delay and proceed directly to the next state. Only has effect whilst the alarm is in arming or pending state.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity for which the delay should be skipped.

enable_user.name: Enable User
enable_user.description: Allow a user to arm/disarm alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to enable.

disable_user.name: Disable User
disable_user.description: Block a user from arming/disarming alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to disable.

issue_push_actions.name: Issue push actions
issue_push_actions.description: Return single-use action ids for a notification you send yourself. The code is never skipped for these actions.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarmo entity the actions apply to.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Alarmo actions to offer as notification buttons.

init.title: Actionable push notifications
init.description: Alarmo adds a single-use token to the action buttons (such as ALARMO_DISARM) of the notifications it sends, and only accepts responses to those notifications.

data_description.push_actions_enabled: Turn off to ignore every ALARMO_* push notification action.
data_description.push_actions_skip_code: When off, a push action that needs a code (for example disarming while a disarm code is required) is only executed when the code is typed in a text input action. Arm actions need a code only when a code is required to arm.
data_description.push_actions_allow_unverified: Also accept action names without a token, for example from your own automations. Any registered mobile device, or anyone who knows a mobile app webhook ID, can send these. Not recommended.
data_description.push_actions_validity: How long the buttons of a notification sent by Alarmo can be used. Each notification can be used once.

push_action_code_input.title: Alarmo notification buttons need the alarm code
push_action_code_input.description: The notifications {automations} have Alarmo action buttons that require the alarm code, but the code cannot be entered. Add `behavior: textInput` to these buttons, or allow push actions without code in the Alarmo options.
